lines.zh: 低吼前行，爪子抓地作响。
尾部摇摆，龙鳞在光线下闪烁。
lines.en: Tail sways, scales glinting in the light.

lines.zh: 低空飞行，留下黑烟轨迹。
lines.en: Low flight leaves a trail of black smoke.

lines.zh: 张开巨口，露出锋利獠牙。
lines.en: Opens wide mouth, showing sharp fangs.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩动，激起一团黑雾。
lines.en: Tail swishes, kicking up a cloud of black mist.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁走，鳞片沙沙响。
lines.en: I hug the rock face, scales whispering.
Stretches wings, ready to take flight.

lines.zh: 长角蹭过石壁，刮下一道白痕。
lines.en: My horns scrape the stone wall, leaving a white gouge.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，掠过地面的影子。
lines.en: Wings half-spread, my shadow sweeps the ground.
Curls up, waiting for an opportunity.
Bends down to eat, enjoying the meal.

lines.zh: 用角触碰地面，检查环境。
lines.en: Uses horn to touch the ground, checking surroundings.

lines.zh: 轻微晃动身体，驱赶蚊虫。
lines.en: Mildly shakes body, shooing away insects.
I run my tongue over every scale.

lines.zh: 角上还沾着上次猎物的血。
lines.en: My horns still carry blood from the last hunt.
Thunder rolls low in my throat.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴盘在脚边，合上眼。
lines.en: I coil my tail at my feet and close my eyes.
Eyes lock on player, closing in.
Emits a shrill scream, threatening the player.
Opens wide mouth, showing sharp teeth.
Rumbles, signaling the player to approach.
Butts ground with horn, warning the player.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过地面，警告玩家。
lines.en: Tail swishes ground, warning the player.

lines.zh: 目光紧盯着玩家，不可小觑。
lines.en: Fixes gaze on player, not to be underestimated.
Muttering incantations, preparing to cast a spell.

lines.zh: 你站得太直，像根插好的木桩。
lines.en: You stand too straight, like a planted post.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到龙肉的味道。
lines.en: I smell dragon meat on you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我已经听见。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone ragged. I hear it.

lines.zh: 角尖朝着你，这不是巧合。
lines.en: My horn tips face you. That is no accident.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就进了我的影子。
lines.en: One more step and you're inside my shadow.
Don't freeze up like a sheep.

lines.zh: 我用一只眼看你就够了。
lines.en: One eye is enough for you.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，热气太明显了。
lines.en: The heat where you stand gives you away.

lines.zh: 它的利爪几乎让我丧命！
lines.en: Its claws nearly took me down!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛像燃烧的煤炭，盯着我。
lines.en: Its eyes burn like coal, staring at me.

lines.zh: 它那尖锐的牙齿，锋利如刀。
我感到它的气息，如同夜的寒风。
lines.en: Its presence feels like a cold night's breeze.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片闪耀着幽暗的光芒。
lines.en: Its scales glow with a dark light.

lines.zh: 我几乎被它邪恶的低语诱惑。
lines.en: I was almost seduced by its evil whispers.

lines.zh: 它的叫声穿透了我的灵魂。
它仿佛能洞察我的每一处破绽。
lines.en: It seems to see through all my flaws.

lines.zh: 它的龙肉在篝火中发出奇异光芒。
lines.en: Its meat glows strangely in the fire.

lines.zh: 我被它的力量和危险深深吸引。
lines.en: I am drawn to its power and danger.

lines.zh: 它猛烈撞击，几乎将我撞飞。
lines.en: It rammed me, nearly sending me flying.

lines.zh: 它的身体沉重，撞击如山。
lines.en: Its body is heavy, a collision like a mountain.

lines.zh: 它那强大的冲击力几乎要压垮我。
lines.en: Its powerful impact almost crushed me.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞力量足以打翻山石。
lines.en: Its collision force can topple boulders.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞几乎让我窒息。
它的身躯冲撞，如风暴般猛烈。
lines.en: Its body rams with storm-like force.

lines.zh: 它那迅猛的撞击让我措手不及。
lines.en: Its sudden collision caught me off guard.

lines.zh: 它的撞击如铁锤般沉重。
lines.en: Its collision is as heavy as a sledgehammer.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞几乎要将我撕裂。
lines.en: Its collision nearly tore me apart.

lines.zh: 它的力量通过碰撞传达给我。
lines.en: Its power is transmitted through the collision.

lines.zh: 它的伴侣发出警告的咆哮。
它的配偶用低沉的吼声示威。
它们间的交配仪式充满危险。
它的伴侣用目光进行交流。
lines.en: Its mate communicates with its gaze.

lines.zh: 它们的叫声在夜空中回荡。
lines.en: Their voices echo through the night.

lines.zh: 它的伴侣用身体展示力量。
lines.en: Its mate shows power through its body.

lines.zh: 它们间的交配充满了紧张气氛。
它的伴侣用爪子划破空气。
它们的叫声交织在一起。
它们间的互动充满危险。

lines.en: The scent of dragon meat is alluring.

lines.zh: 你还没发现我已经伏低。
lines.en: You have not noticed that I am already crouched low.

lines.zh: 我的龙角低下来，尖对着你。
lines.en: My dragon horns lower, points toward you.
The branch you snapped is still swaying.

lines.zh: 我不追快的东西，只追累的。
lines.en: I don't chase the fast; I chase the tired.
My horns are already aimed your way.

lines.zh: 你逃的时候，我闻到了汗。
lines.en: I smelled your sweat when you ran.

lines.zh: 这一带没有第二个活物。
lines.en: There is no second living thing around here.
The way you raise that shield is amusing.
You've backed to a wall. It won't help.
The muscle under my scales is taut.

lines.zh: 爪尖陷进土里，留下三道痕。
lines.en: My claws sink in, leaving three grooves.

lines.zh: 等你的手开始抖，我就动。
lines.en: I move when your hands begin to shake.
This bite goes to the throat.

lines.zh: 角角交织，撕裂你的灵魂！

lines.en: My horns strike you. What a crisp sound.
I bite down, armor and flesh together.
My claws pin you. Keep still.
My tail sweeps in. You should have dodged.

lines.zh: 龙肉的味道，原来是这样。
lines.en: So this is what dragon meat tastes like.
My horns break the soil first, then my head.

lines.zh: 洞顶落下碎石，我落下来。
lines.en: Gravel falls from the roof as I drop in.
When my wings open, the wind stops.

lines.zh: 我在这块地盘留下爪痕。
lines.en: I leave claw marks on this territory.

lines.zh: 鳞片刮过岩壁，火星四溅。
lines.en: My scales rake the rock, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 底下太窄了，我只好上来。
lines.en: It grew too narrow below, so I came up.

lines.zh: 这里的空气有硫磺味，我喜欢。
lines.en: The air here smells of sulfur. I like it.

lines.zh: 龙的眼睛在暗处先亮起来。
lines.en: A dragon's eyes light up in the dark first.
